Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models (FlashMorph, 2026)
edges.note: Where the Transformer uses full attention in every layer, FlashMorph keeps full attention in only a chosen subset and converts the rest to linear attention, selecting the subset by joint gate optimization under a budget.

edges.target_label: Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models (FlashMorph, 2026)
edges.note: Where Mamba replaces attention wholesale with a state space model, FlashMorph keeps a chosen subset of full-attention layers and converts only the rest, treating the choice as a joint optimization rather than a fixed pattern.

edges.target_label: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus (2026)
edges.note: Where HARMamba argued that bidirectional state space layers can replace attention and evaluated by downstream accuracy, this paper keeps both layer types and evaluates by internal activation statistics.

edges.target_label: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus (2026)
edges.note: Where Bi-Mamba+ substituted selective state space layers for attention in long-horizon forecasting, this paper measures what the mixture does to numerical range, which is the property that governs low-bit quantization.

edges.target_label: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus (2026)
edges.note: Full attention is treated as the limit point that hybrid outlier morphology converges toward as the hybridization ratio rises.

edges.target_label: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning (2026)
edges.note: Softmax attention over a growing key-value cache is the retrieval baseline whose fixed-size compression this paper reinterprets as an online regression problem.

edges.target_label: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning (2026)
edges.note: Mamba-2 established the duality between selective state-space models and linear attention as matrix computations; this paper reads the shared update as a step of online learning instead.

edges.target_label: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning (2026)
edges.note: Mamba introduced input-dependent selective gating of a fixed-size state; this paper argues that gate optimizes a misaligned target and replaces it with normalized least-mean-squares updates.

edges.target_label: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture (2026)
edges.note: Attention Is All You Need supplies the full-attention layer this architecture keeps at one in four and then replaces with a block-sparse variant after pretraining.

edges.target_label: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture (2026)
edges.note: Mamba-2 established the linear-time recurrence that Gated DeltaNet extends with a delta rule; this report fixes how many such layers can stand in for attention rather than claiming they replace it.

edges.target_label: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture (2026)
edges.note: Mamba proposed selective state-space models as an outright substitute for attention on long sequences; this report measures the hybrid ratio instead and retains one full-attention layer in four.

edges.target_label: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM (2026)
edges.note: Audio Mamba established what a fixed-size recurrent state can represent over a long continuous sequence; this paper measures how much numerical precision that state needs and answers four bits.

edges.target_label: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM (2026)
edges.note: MambaOut asked when the recurrence contributes at all; this paper turns the same ablation on precision rather than presence and inverts the inherited assumption that the recurrent half is the fragile part of a hybrid model.

edges.target_label: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V2 answers the same memory problem by compressing the KV cache rather than replacing it with a recurrence; if the recurrent half is also the cheap half to quantize, the memory argument for latent KV compression weakens relative to hybrid designs.
